deviations: Context (DJ): RA-2's row (§5 L224) names no page, so the board draws the entry gate of RA-1 (L223): SCR-149 over the Owner's SCR-010 workspace, the previous non-admin route, with gate.body 'until 14:17 UTC' (D6 L119), as boards 11 and 13 do: boards 11-13 run entry → verifying → wrong. The held-save gate (gate.body_held over SCR-122, RA-5 L227) shows the same RA-2 changes; boards 15-18 draw that gate. The workspace is E10's WorkspaceCanvas as one neutral placeholder (kit app_shell), unmasked under the scrim: the gate is not a lock (L213). No CMP-087 band, rule, strip or PageHeader is drawn: under D6 no admin data renders before the unlock (as board 11 records).

Cancel and Esc stay live while verifying (DJ): RA-2 locks the fields only (L224), and §5 L236-237 makes Enter inert while verifying but keeps Esc = Cancel, so Cancel (T1, secondary) returns to the workspace as in RA-1 (D6 L119; D06:52); D02:270 had 'controls disabled'. Spec question for #886: confirm, or name Cancel in RA-2's row; either way say what the client does with the answer that still arrives (a 200 still elevates the session, L217; a 401 still counts toward the three strikes, L219; the third still makes the session read-only, RA-4 L226, which the owner sees only if the client handles that late 403) and where focus goes after Cancel (the gate's opener, 05:97).

gate.cancel_note ('Cancel discards nothing; you return to your workspace.') stays under the status line: §14 L601's 'RA-1 only' is read as the entry gate, never RA-5's held-save gate, where Cancel keeps the page (RA-6, L228); boards 11 and 13 draw the same gate. Spec edit for #886 (settles boards 12 and 13): in §14 L601, 'RA-1 only' → 'the entry gate only, never the held-save gate (RA-5)'.

gate.body's '14:17' stays in the sentence's type.ui.body, as boards 11 and 13 set the same body: a time inside a sentence keeps the sentence's type, as board 93's NUM_DEV words it (D02:120's type.num.base goes to clocks and counts shown as values, such as band.unlocked's '12:40' on board 01; none is drawn here).

No focus ring in the gate (DJ, as boards 93 and 101): RA-2 moves no focus (L224; RA-3 returns it to Password, L225), so focus stays on the control that sent the request: the field where Enter was pressed, or Unlock admin, busy and still focusable (D09:231), after a click, Enter or Space; drawing either would choose one.

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

aria-busy="true" is noted on the form that holds the two fields (E09-D04:90: 'on the form') and on Unlock admin (15:54); the status line sits outside the busy form, so its polite announcement is not held back while the form is busy (DJ: RA-2, L224, names aria-busy without its element).

CMP-201's reveal toggle ('Show password'; showReveal defaults to true, 15:2346-2347) is not drawn: §5 L236's Tab order Password → code → Cancel → Unlock admin (and §13 L582) has no stop for it. Spec gap for #886 (shared with board 11): either the gate sets showReveal false or its Tab order gains the toggle; if it is kept, RA-2's row (L224) must also say whether it stays live while the form is aria-busy or locks with the fields.

Gate fields: the CMP-040 label above the well (the kit's field()); both wells span the dialog's inner 432 px (no source gives the field widths; D02:262-263 is a wireframe), as boards 93 and 101 draw them.

The fields keep the values that were sent (L224 'fields locked'), as boards 93 and 101 draw kept values: the password as eight mask dots (e42kit PASSWORD_MASK; no source gives a password or its length) in the kit's locked look, color.text.tertiary on sunken (6.83, §15 L650's pair), and the code as a neutral placeholder bar (color.surface.hover, radius.control, 48 px, about six type.num.base digits): no source gives a code. The words 'Verifying code…' and the busy button carry the locked state, never the dimming alone.

CMP-204 is drawn as one well, as D7 words it ('one input', L120) and as boards 11 and 13 draw it; CMP-204's six visually segmented cells (15:2374 'navigation between cells'; D02:263 '[_ _ _ _ _ _]') are the component's own look, and no source gives their geometry.

Busy look (DJ): RA-2 (L224) gives the words, not their place. Unlock admin takes CMP-001's loading state: the spinner in place of the label at the label's width, so nothing reflows (15:51, :53), aria-busy (15:54), still focusable (D09:231), its name 'Unlock admin' kept in the DOM (E09-D04:91). 'Verifying code…' (gate.verifying) is a role=status line in the slot under the code, where RA-3's error and RA-10/RA-11's lines go (L213, L225, L232-233): D02:270's 'inline spinner text' and E09-D04:91's polite region, its spinner the button's (one spinner, not a second one from CMP-038, 15:389-393). The line is type.ui.caption in color.text.secondary (8.14 on overlay, §15 L648), as board 11 sets its cancel note (kit choice). Busy is not disabled: D7 (L120) keeps Unlock admin enabled; while busy its activation is inert, like Enter (L236-237). Not T2 (G-T2): E09-D09 §9.1 gives loading its own row, aria-busy and focusable (D09:231), apart from both T2 rows (D09:228-229); nothing here is role- or state-gated: Cancel is T1, and the Admin entry is the Owner's, absent for other roles (E10-D02:64).

The kit's dialog() note says 'the first sentence is the description'; the gate's description is the whole body, both sentences (L237; D02:271), so this board replaces the dialog's note.
